Manifest.Name: 垃圾场拾荒地图 / Dumping Ground Map
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description: 前往垃圾场时先打开地图选一块地标，确认后进入该区域，之后拾荒不再询问，本次停留内连续沿用；离开垃圾场后重新选择。地图共 5 个区域，分两档：低级区（无门槛）入口空地、生活废料带；高级区（声望解锁）拆解堆 40 点、医疗废弃点 50 点、废武器堆 60 点。声望按存档独立结算：每趟拾荒捡到的东西按当前金币价值累计，每 100 点价值记 1 点声望，用 ModHelper 的 mod 数据接口存进存档本体的 PlayerStore.modData（键 rep_total_value），随存档一起保存，不进 ModConfig，换存档或开新档从 0 开始；落盘时机是一天结束时的存档，中途强退当晚声望会丢，与当晚其它收益一致。未解锁的地标在地图上压暗并在编号后标出门槛，点它会提示还差多少声望。声望同时作为一行「垃圾场」出现在商店评价箱（FeedbackBox）的派系声望面板里：标题后是等级名（拾荒客 / 熟脸 / 老手 / 活地图），数字是「当前/下一门槛」，满 60 后显示累计点数，绿条按 0–60 总进度。这一行只在面板打开时于内存里合成，不写存档；检测到災變日或 ReputationInterfaceRemake 时自动跳过，避免双行或空行。掉落由「原版表 → 本区主题表」的线性插值决定，垃圾也参与插值。垃圾 100%、专精全部时：入口 12.26、拆解 12.26、生活 12.26、医疗 14.10、废武器 14.10；默认档（垃圾 50%、专精较多）依次为 16.66 / 18.54 / 16.53 / 18.35 / 19.16，高级三区都高于低级两区。垃圾基准占比：入口 48.8%、拆解 59.9%、生活 47.7%、医疗 46.5%、废武器 51.4%。类别内物品比例回归原版，不再人工压低。设置项不变：垃圾出现率倍率（0–100%，默认 50%，是「该区基础垃圾率」的倍率而非垃圾占比）、高档物资出现率（0–30%，默认 0%）、区域专精度四档（较少 25% / 中等 50% / 较多 75% / 全部 100%，默认较多）。设置窗口先给一行固定的原版参考（垃圾 100%、无专精：五区都是 12.26），再用「原版 → 现在」列出当前设置下五区各自的结果、各区平均与三个预设；拖动实时刷新，松手或点「应用」才写盘。 / When travelling to the Dumping Ground, pick a landmark first and enter that area; later searches reuse it for the rest of the visit, and the choice resets when you leave. The map has five areas in two tiers: low tier, no requirement (Main Gate, Refuse Lane) and high tier unlocked by reputation (Scrap Pile 40, Medical Waste 50, Weapon Dump 60). Reputation is tracked per save: every haul adds the current cash value of what you picked up, 100 value = 1 point, stored in the save file itself through ModHelper's mod data API (PlayerStore.modData, key rep_total_value). It never goes into ModConfig, and each save or new game starts from zero. It is written when the day ends, so quitting mid-night loses that night's reputation, just like the rest of that night's gains. The mod does not read or write any files. Reputation also shows up as a "The Dump" row in the store's feedback-box faction panel: tier name (Scavenger / Regular / Old Hand / Living Map), current/next threshold, total points once past 60, and a bar on a 0-60 scale. The row is built in memory only when the panel opens and never touches the save; it is skipped entirely when DisasterDay or ReputationInterfaceRemake is loaded, to avoid duplicate or empty rows. Locked landmarks are dimmed, carry their requirement next to the number, and explain the shortfall when clicked. Loot is a linear blend between the vanilla table and the area's themed table, junk included. At 100% junk and full specialty: Main Gate 12.26, Scrap Pile 12.26, Refuse Lane 12.26, Medical Waste 14.10, Weapon Dump 14.10. At the default (50% junk, High specialty): 16.66 / 18.54 / 16.53 / 18.35 / 19.16, so all three gated areas beat both low-tier ones. Base junk shares: 48.8% / 59.9% / 47.7% / 46.5% / 51.4%. Within-category ratios follow vanilla again, with no manual suppression. Settings are unchanged: a junk chance multiplier (0-100%, default 50% - a multiplier on each area's base junk chance, not a junk share), a high-value chance slider (0-30%, default 0%) and a four-tier specialty dropdown (Rare 25% / Medium 50% / High 75% / All 100%, default High). The settings window first shows a fixed vanilla reference (100% junk, no specialty: 12.26 everywhere), then "vanilla -> now" for each area at the current settings, the average and three presets. Everything refreshes while dragging; the config is written on release or when Apply is pressed.
